settings.heading: Build their routine
settings.subheading: Three questions, and that's the whole quiz. How old is your child?

settings.result: Little Explorers: gentle, tear-free, and simple enough for them to start doing it themselves.
Big Kids: cleansing that keeps up with a full day outdoors, without stripping a still-developing barrier.
Tweens: grown-up textures and finishes for changing skin and oilier hair — minus the harsh adult actives.

settings.heading: Three moments, that's the whole routine

settings.moments:
Morning | A quick rinse with the Gentle Body Wash — fast enough that it doesn't turn into a wrestling match.
Bath time | 2-in-1 Shampoo + Conditioner so wash day stops being a fight over tangles.
Bedtime | A little Nourishing Body Massage Oil worked in while you read one more story.

Morning | Gentle Body Wash after an early game or practice — it clears real playground grime without stripping.
Bath time | 2-in-1 Shampoo + Conditioner, then Nourishing Hair Oil twice a week for strength.
Bedtime | Deep Hydration Body Lotion on knees, elbows and shins that took the day's beating.

Morning | Gentle Body Wash, daily — changing skin means oil and sweat arrive earlier than you expect.
Bath time | 2-in-1 Shampoo + Conditioner for oilier roots, with Hair Oil on lengths only.
Bedtime | Deep Hydration Body Lotion — a grown-up finish, without the adult actives.

settings.question: How old does my child need to be to start?
settings.answer: Every product in the range is formulated for ages 4–12.

settings.question: Can I mix and match across age stages?
settings.answer: Yes — the age stages are a starting guide, not a strict rule.

settings.question: How often should they use the hair oil?
settings.answer: Twice a week is plenty for most children. Work it through the lengths, leave it on for 30 minutes or overnight, then wash out with the 2-in-1.
